text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday it had completed the refinancing of its corporate debt facilities, cancelling US$1.45 billion in debt and drawing down US$1.2 billion under a new facility concluded on Monday.
The new facility is in two tranches of US$950 million for five years and US$250 million for seven years, Woodside said.

"In addition to substantial cost savings from reduction in margins and fees, the new facility...will enable the group to maintain flexible funding facilities for general corporate purposes and to cater for its anticipated forward capital expenditure programme...," it said.
The facility extended the group's debt maturity consistent with its forecast cash flow profile, Woodside said.
Woodside has maintained its relationship with a core syndicate of nine banks, including Australian, North American, European and Japanese banks.
Chase Securities Australia Ltd remains agent for the bank syndicate.
